request.style: English, hymn, solo male voice with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, reverent and urgent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He passed by and saw a man
Blind from his earliest days
The disciples stood and asked
Who sinned to cause such pain

[Verse]
Neither this man nor his parents
Did sin to bring this state
It happened so the works of God
Might be revealed in his fate

[Chorus]
We must do the works of him
Who sent me while it is day
Night is coming when no one
Can work in the fading light

[Verse]
As long as I am in the world
I am the light of the world
He spat on the ground and made
Mud with his saliva poured

[Chorus]
We must do the works of him
Who sent me while it is day
Night is coming when no one
Can work in the fading light

[Bridge]
He spread it on the man's eyes
And told him to go and wash
In the pool of Siloam
Which means the one who was sent

[Outro]
So the man went and washed
And came back seeing the light
Work while it is day
Before the night arrives
